purpose: Follow-up mechanism evidence for PR; not replacement for frozen full-forward accuracy result
reference: Same complete CUDA graph, real model checkpoint and prefilled KV, 5 profiled replays after unprofiled timing
negative_control: FP8 M16 N12288 K8192 (96MiB weights, larger than L2), copies1/2/4
measurement: Common 72 GEMM operations per captured graph; 5 blocks of 50 timed replays, 25 warmups; profile5 graph replays separately
comparison: Exact CUDA GEMM kernel-name match between model graph and isolated graph; report per-shape kernel durations and whole-op rotation curve; no prediction recalibration
limitation: CUPTI timing is diagnostic; both sides profiled with same method. No L2 hardware counters available from installed ncu.
